turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My thyroid test was in the portal and I did not understand it.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your TSH is 5.8, which is slightly high.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take levothyroxine 50 mcg every morning.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any new fatigue or cold intolerance?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Some fatigue, but no cold intolerance.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Let us increase to 75 mcg and recheck the TSH in six weeks.
